title: SAM
tagline: AI voice assistant application to  make your onchain transactions seemlesly. Multi and Cross Chain
description: The application will inctroduce you a new and fresh way to make your own transactions whenever you want just with your voice. Tell the applicatin what you want and the rest will be the SAM's duty. Sam will process data, create transactions and make crosschain swap, buy and sell processese under the hood. The next version of SAM will include AI based token, wallet and asset ( NFT ) alerts to tell you when a threshold for both ways triggered. For example: tell SAM Tell me when DAI token hits the X market cap. And rest is just SAM's some intelligent processing.
how_its_made: The project made all in hackathon. The idea and the project almost finished for technical aspects. The world minikit application, 1inch connections, blockscout implementation are halfly baked and made as much for the hackathon. The rest technologies will be continued to developing through next weeks. The SAM will be alive and usable soon.
